items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued September 14 at 2:23AM EDT until September 15 at 12:00PM EDT by NWS Wilmington NC
items.description:
* WHAT...Northeast winds 15 to 20 kt with gusts up to 25 kt
expected.

* WHERE...Southeast North Carolina coastal waters out 20 NM.

* WHEN...From 8 PM this evening to noon EDT Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
